evidence.reason: The blocking denylist scan runs gitleaks over `git log -p` with `DIFF_OPTS` lacking `--no-renames`. Git rename detection can emit an unchanged rename with no added text, and gitleaks scans added text, so content moved from an exempt/allowlisted path to a non-exempt path can evade both content scanning and path-based rules. The surrounding comment states these options exist to force raw text diffs so a scanned revision cannot hide content; this omission permits that bypass. The current contract requires the denylist to remain blocking, and no accepted limitation or retirement covers rename evasion. The smallest compatible repair is to add `--no-renames` in the denylist template/workflow.
